# Helios AI Monthly Optimization Report

Client:
Package:
Month:
Retainer Status:

## 1. System Summary

Briefly explain what system is active (channels, booking flow, dashboard). One short paragraph.

## 2. Lead Activity

Summarize leads, inquiries, bookings, or customer messages if data is available.
If no data is available, say what should be connected or tracked next — do not estimate or invent numbers.

## 3. Issues Found

List broken flows, unclear FAQs, missed notifications, weak responses, or problems found this month. If none: "No issues found this month."

## 4. Improvements Made

List updates completed this month (FAQ updates, response improvements, flow fixes, content changes).

## 5. Recommended Next Improvements

List practical next improvements. Careful language only — "could improve response speed", "may capture more after-hours inquiries", "should be verified". Never promise revenue.

## 6. Client Action Items

List anything the client needs to provide or confirm (updated prices, new services, holiday hours, photos, approvals).

## 7. Next Review Date

[Date — also update `next_review_date` and `last_report_date` on the client record in /admin/clients.]
